metrics.definition: Fractions; AIA is mean stage sample-weighted all-seen accuracy; forgetting averages old tasks only.

criterion: The sole surviving complete ImageNet-R fixed-library candidate has completed all10 fixed internal training-holdout stages and passed checkpoint/state audits. Lock this existing configuration without introducing further ImageNet-R module HPO. Formal test scores were not read or used.
interpretation: The completed one-seed development result supports freezing this candidate for formal refit. It does not establish multi-seed stability, beneficial future-class reuse, causal module value or an efficiency advantage over alternatives.

formal_refit.initialization: Fresh original pretrained weights and new optimizers; no development resume, statistics or learned parameters.
formal_refit.training_count_basis: Official training split, equal to the21689 fitting plus2311 internal holdout rows used during development; validation_only=false restores all original training rows.
formal_refit.scope: Full10 stages,20 new classes each; test all seen classes without task ID.

required_predecessor.condition: Natural successful completion and terminal original process identity; validate completion using status/stage count without consulting its accuracy for selection.

launch_constraints.placement: Preferred physical/logical GPU1; this module method does not use a CE execution cache.
launch_constraints.resources: Run the current resource preflight before dispatch and reserve the measured module budget plus safety margin; prepared files do not authorize ignoring live jobs or VRAM.
launch_constraints.enforcement: Generic launch_jobs.py does not enforce these metadata guards; the scheduler must verify them immediately before launch.

hpo_closure_scope: ImageNet-R current_adapted only; no new ImageNet-R module candidate is introduced. Existing CIFAR MB2 development continuation remains separate.
